settings.heading: One region. One flower. One honest jar.
settings.text: Most honey is blended from many sources and heated so it pours forever and tastes the same. Ours isn't. Every BeeBlend honey comes from a single region, stays separate from hive to jar, and is never heated. So a spoon of Kashmiri Acacia tastes nothing like Himalayan Multi-Flora. That's the whole point.
settings.points:
Raw & never heated
One region per jar
Nothing added, ever

settings.heading: Honey you can trace back to its flower
settings.text:
We started BeeBlend because most honey on the shelf can't tell you where it came from. So we do it the slow way: we work with beekeepers in specific regions, from the Kashmir valley to the Himalayan foothills, and keep every harvest in its own jar.

No heating to make it pour. No syrups to stretch it. Just raw honey with the colour, aroma and taste of the place it was made. That's why it crystallises naturally, and why every jar tastes different.

settings.title: Bees gather nectar
settings.text: From a single dominant flower source in one region.

settings.title: The hive turns it into honey
settings.text: Bees evaporate the moisture and cap each cell with wax when it's ripe.

settings.title: We jar it raw
settings.text: Extracted and gently filtered, never heated, so the enzymes and flavour stay intact.

settings.heading: From hive to jar
settings.text: Three steps, and none of them involve heat or additives.

settings.us: Single origin, one region per jar

settings.heading: Not all honey is the same
settings.text: Most supermarket honey is heated and blended from many sources. Ours isn't.
